sections.title: Daily
sections.sub: Waking, sleeping, eating, wudu, leaving home
sections.about: Short du'as the Prophet ﷺ taught for everyday moments. Imam al-Nawawi رحمه الله (d. 676 AH), the great hadith scholar, gathered them with their sources in his book al-Adhkar. Learn one at a time and say it each time that moment comes.
sections.credit: Sources: Imam al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, with the hadith collections he cites.

items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say on waking
items.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.en: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the return.

items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say on going to bed
items.ar: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَحْيَا وَأَمُوتُ
items.en: In Your name, O Allah, I live and I die.

items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (6320) and Muslim (2714); al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say on going to bed
items.ar: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.en: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
items.note: The Prophet ﷺ also blew into his ﷺ hands, recited al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and al-Nas and wiped his ﷺ body (al-Bukhari and Muslim).

items.src: al-Bukhari (142) and Muslim (375), with 'bismillah' in Abu Dawud and al-Tirmidhi; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
items.en: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.

items.src: Abu Dawud (30) and al-Tirmidhi (7), the rest in al-Nasa'i and Ibn Majah; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.ar: غُفْرَانَكَ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنِّي الْأَذَى وَعَافَانِي
items.en: I ask Your forgiveness. Praise be to Allah who took away the harm from me and gave me well-being.

items.src: Sahih Muslim, from 'Umar رضي الله عنه, with the last line added in al-Tirmidhi; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say after wudu
items.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
items.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me of those who repent and of those who purify themselves.

items.src: Abu Dawud and Ibn al-Sunni (272), from Mu'adh ibn Anas رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.en: Praise be to Allah who clothed me in this and provided it for me, with no power or strength from me.
items.note: The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever says it has his past sins forgiven.

items.src: Abu Dawud (5095) and al-Tirmidhi (3426), from Anas رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.en: In the name of Allah. I put my trust in Allah. There is no power and no strength except by Allah.
items.note: It is said to him: you are guided, protected and sufficed, and Shaytan moves away from him.

items.src: Abu Dawud, from Abu Malik al-Ash'ari رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلَجِ، وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ، بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِاسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of entering and the good of leaving. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
items.note: Then greet your family with salam.

items.src: al-Bukhari and Muslim; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, saying bismillah over food
items.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.en: In the name of Allah.
items.note: If you forget at the start, say: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ — 'In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end' (Abu Dawud and al-Tirmidhi).

items.src: Abu Dawud, al-Tirmidhi (3458) and Ibn Majah (3285); al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say after eating
items.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.en: Praise be to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me, with no power or strength from me.
items.note: Whoever says it has his past sins forgiven. Al-Tirmidhi: hasan.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.en: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
items.note: Send salam on the Prophet ﷺ first (Abu Dawud) and enter with the right foot.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.en: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

items.src: Abu Dawud and al-Tirmidhi; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, morning and evening
items.ar: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ، ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ
items.en: Recite al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and al-Nas three times, morning and evening.
items.note: 'They will suffice you against everything.' Al-Tirmidhi: hasan sahih.

items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (6323), from Shaddad ibn Aws رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, morning and evening
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ
items.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I acknowledge Your blessings on me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done.
items.note: Whoever says it in the evening and dies that night is of the people of Paradise, and likewise in the morning.

items.src: Sahih Muslim, from Ibn 'Umar رضي الله عنهما; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say when mounting
items.ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا، وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
items.en: Glory be to the One who subjected this to us, and we could not have done it ourselves; to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey for righteousness and piety, and deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who looks after the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, a sad sight, and a bad return to wealth and family.
items.note: Say 'Allahu akbar' three times first. On returning, add: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.

items.src: al-Bukhari (6345) and Muslim (2730), from Ibn 'Abbas رضي الله عنهما; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, times of hardship
items.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.en: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the noble Throne.

items.src: Ibn al-Sunni (341), from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari رضي الله عنه; also in Musnad Ahmad from Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, times of hardship
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، فِي قَبْضَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ نُورَ صَدْرِي، وَرَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
items.en: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, in Your grasp. My forelock is in Your hand; Your judgement over me is done and Your decree for me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, by which You named Yourself, or sent down in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept with You in the knowledge of the unseen, to make the Mighty Qur'an the light of my chest, the spring of my heart, the removal of my sorrow and the end of my worry.
items.note: The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever says them, seeking what is in them, Allah removes his grief and lengthens his joy. 'Say them and teach them.'

items.src: al-Bukhari (5743) and Muslim (2191), from 'A'ishah رضي الله عنها; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.en: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness.
items.note: He ﷺ would wipe with his ﷺ right hand while saying it.

items.src: Sahih Muslim (2202), from 'Uthman ibn Abi al-'As رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar

parts.do: Put your hand where it hurts and say three times:
parts.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
parts.en: In the name of Allah.

parts.ar: أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
parts.en: I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.

items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (1032), from 'A'ishah رضي الله عنها; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
items.en: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.

items.src: al-Tirmidhi (3451), from Talhah رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
items.en: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, safety and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
items.note: Al-Tirmidhi: hasan.

items.src: Ibn al-Sunni, from 'Ali رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
items.en: Praise be to Allah. O Allah, as You have made my form beautiful, make my character beautiful.

items.src: al-Tirmidhi (3428), from 'Umar رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say on entering the market
items.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.

items.ar: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
items.en: May Allah have mercy on you.
items.note: The one who sneezes says 'al-hamdu lillah'; whoever hears him replies 'yarhamuk Allah'.

sections.title: Prophets

items.t: Adam عليه السلام and Hawwa' عليهما السلام: after their slip
items.ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَٰسِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

items.t: Nuh عليه السلام: for himself, his parents and the believers
items.ar: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنٗا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَا
items.en: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my house as a believer, and the believing men and women; and increase the wrongdoers only in ruin.

items.t: Nuh عليه السلام: on leaving the Ark
items.ar: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلٗا مُّبَارَكٗا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
items.en: My Lord, let me land in a blessed landing place, for You are the best to bring to land.

items.t: Ibrahim and Isma'il عليهما السلام: building the Ka'bah
items.ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةٗ مُّسْلِمَةٗ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, accept this from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. Our Lord, make us submit to You, and from our offspring a nation that submits to You; show us our rites, and turn to us in mercy: You are the Ever-Relenting, the Most Merciful.

items.t: Ibrahim عليه السلام: for prayer and forgiveness
items.ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.en: My Lord, make me one who establishes the prayer, and from my offspring too. Our Lord, accept my prayer. Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day the reckoning is established.

items.t: Ibrahim عليه السلام: for wisdom and the righteous
items.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمٗا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّـٰلِحِينَ
items.en: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous.

items.ar: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
items.en: My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.

items.t: Yusuf عليه السلام: at the end of his story
items.ar: رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْأٓخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمٗا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّـٰلِحِينَ
items.en: My Lord, You have given me kingship and taught me the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and the earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Take me as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

items.t: Shu'ayb عليه السلام: for a just judgement
items.ar: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَٰتِحِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, judge between us and our people with the truth, for You are the best of judges.

items.t: Musa عليه السلام: before speaking to Pharaoh
items.ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِيٓ أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُواْ قَوْلِي
items.en: My Lord, open my heart for me, make my task easy for me, and untie the knot from my tongue so they understand my speech.

items.t: Musa عليه السلام: in need, at Madyan
items.ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٖ فَقِيرٞ
items.en: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.

items.t: Ayyub عليه السلام: in his illness
items.ar: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّـٰحِمِينَ
items.en: Harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

items.t: Yunus عليه السلام: in the belly of the whale
items.ar: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ
items.en: There is no god but You; glory be to You; I was among the wrongdoers.

items.ar: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِيٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِيٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ
items.en: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful for Your favour which You have given me and my parents, and to do good that pleases You; and by Your mercy admit me among Your righteous servants.

items.t: Zakariyya عليه السلام: for a child
items.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةٗ طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَآءِ
items.en: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. You hear every prayer.

items.t: Zakariyya عليه السلام: not to be left alone
items.ar: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدٗا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَٰرِثِينَ
items.en: My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors.

items.t: 'Isa عليه السلام: for the table from heaven
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةٗ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدٗا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةٗ مِّنكَ وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّـٰزِقِينَ
items.en: O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table spread from heaven, to be a festival for the first and last of us and a sign from You; and provide for us, for You are the best of providers.

items.ar: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمٗا
items.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

items.t: Muhammad ﷺ: for forgiveness and mercy
items.ar: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّـٰحِمِينَ
items.en: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of the merciful.

sections.about: The Qur'an keeps the very words with which the Prophets عليهم السلام turned to Allah: Adam عليه السلام in repentance, Yunus عليه السلام in the whale, Ayyub عليه السلام in illness, Musa عليه السلام in need, and our Prophet ﷺ asking for knowledge. Make them your own du'as.
sections.sub: The words the Prophets عليهم السلام called on Allah with

sections.title: 40 Rabbana
sections.sub: Du'as from the Qur'an that begin 'Our Lord'
sections.about: Forty du'as from the Qur'an that begin رَبَّنَا, 'Our Lord'. They are the words of the prophets عليهم السلام and the believers, which Allah kept in His Book. Many people read all forty after a prayer, or one a day. Some printed booklets count Fatir 35:34 or al-Tahrim 66:11 among the forty, but neither begins with رَبَّنَا, so this list has al-Nisa' 4:75 and the end of al-Hashr 59:10 in their place.
sections.credit: Qur'an text: Tanzil Project (tanzil.net), CC BY 3.0, copied verbatim.

items.t: 1. Ibrahim and Isma'il عليهما السلام, building the Ka'bah
items.ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, accept this from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
items.who: Ibrahim and Isma'il عليهما السلام, building the Ka'bah

items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, make us submit to You, and of our descendants a nation that submits to You. Show us our rites, and turn to us in mercy; You are the Relenting, the Merciful.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet firm and help us against the disbelieving people.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
items.en: Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا
items.en: Our Lord, do not place on us a burden like that You placed on those before us.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
items.en: Our Lord, do not let our hearts swerve after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. You are the Giver.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
items.en: Our Lord, You will gather mankind on a Day about which there is no doubt. Allah does not break His promise.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.en: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we believe in what You sent down and we follow the Messenger, so write us among those who bear witness.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs, make our feet firm and help us against the disbelieving people.

items.t: 13. People of understanding, reflecting on creation
items.ar: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.en: Our Lord, You did not create this in vain. Glory be to You; protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
items.who: People of understanding, reflecting on creation

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
items.en: Our Lord, whoever You admit to the Fire You have disgraced, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.

items.ar: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا
items.en: Our Lord, we heard a caller calling to faith: 'Believe in your Lord', and we believed.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
items.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins, wipe away our misdeeds, and take us with the righteous.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
items.en: Our Lord, give us what You promised us through Your Messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. You do not break Your promise.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ الظَّالِمِ أَهْلُهَا وَاجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا وَاجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا
items.en: Our Lord, bring us out of this town whose people are oppressors, and appoint for us from Yourself a protector and a helper.

items.t: 19. Those who wept on hearing the truth
items.ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we believe, so write us among those who bear witness.
items.who: Those who wept on hearing the truth

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا وَآيَةً مِّنكَ وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
items.en: O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table spread from heaven, to be a festival for the first and last of us and a sign from You. Provide for us; You are the best of providers.

items.t: 21. Adam عليه السلام and Hawwa' عليهما السلام
items.ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.
items.who: Adam عليه السلام and Hawwa' عليهما السلام

items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth; You are the best of judges.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, pour patience upon us and let us die as Muslims.

items.t: 25. The people of Musa عليه السلام
items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people, and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
items.who: The people of Musa عليه السلام

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
items.en: Our Lord, You know what we hide and what we show; nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden from Allah.

items.ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
items.en: My Lord, make me one who establishes the prayer, and of my descendants too. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.en: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day the reckoning takes place.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
items.en: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and set right our affair for us.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
items.en: Our Lord, we fear that he will hasten against us or transgress.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us; You are the best of those who show mercy.

items.t: 32. The servants of the Most Merciful
items.ar: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
items.en: Our Lord, turn away from us the punishment of Hell; its punishment is lasting. It is an evil place to settle and to stay.
items.who: The servants of the Most Merciful

items.t: 33. The servants of the Most Merciful
items.ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
items.en: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and children the coolness of our eyes, and make us leaders of the God-fearing.
items.who: The servants of the Most Merciful

items.t: 34. The angels who carry the Throne
items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
items.en: Our Lord, You embrace all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and protect them from the punishment of Hell.
items.who: The angels who carry the Throne

items.t: 35. The angels who carry the Throne
items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, admit them to the Gardens of Eden which You promised them, with the righteous among their fathers, spouses and descendants; You are the Mighty, the Wise. Protect them from evil deeds; whoever You protect from evil that Day, You have had mercy on him, and that is the great triumph.
items.who: The angels who carry the Throne

items.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
items.en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who came before us in faith, and do not put in our hearts any rancour towards those who believe.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
items.en: Our Lord, You are Most Kind, Most Merciful.

items.t: 38. Ibrahim عليه السلام and those with him
items.ar: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
items.en: Our Lord, upon You we rely, to You we turn, and to You is the return.
items.who: Ibrahim عليه السلام and those with him

items.t: 39. Ibrahim عليه السلام and those with him
items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord. You are the Mighty, the Wise.
items.who: Ibrahim عليه السلام and those with him

items.t: 40. The believers on the Day of Resurrection
items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.en: Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us; You have power over all things.
items.who: The believers on the Day of Resurrection

sections.title: Al-Wird al-Latif
sections.sub: Imam al-Haddad's morning and evening wird
sections.about: Imam 'Abd Allah ibn 'Alawi al-Haddad رحمه الله (d. 1132 AH) of Tarim in Hadramawt gathered this short wird almost entirely from the Qur'an and the morning and evening du'as of the Prophet ﷺ. It takes about fifteen minutes. Read it once after Fajr and once after 'Asr or Maghrib, in this order, with the number of times shown on each line.
sections.credit: Order and counts as in the printed wird. Qur'an text: Tanzil Project (tanzil.net), CC BY 3.0, copied verbatim. The other lines are the Prophet's ﷺ du'as as al-Nawawi gives them in al-Adhkar, in Imam al-Haddad's wording (he adds سيدنا before the Prophet's ﷺ name, and joins some du'as together).

parts.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
parts.en: Say: He is Allah, One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He did not beget, nor was He begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.

parts.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
parts.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of the darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of the envier when he envies.

parts.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
parts.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.

items.t: Refuge, and verses of the Qur'an

parts.ar: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
parts.en: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the promptings of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their coming near me.

parts.ar: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ ﴿١١٥﴾ فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ ﴿١١٦﴾ وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ ﴿١١٧﴾ وَقُل رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ ﴿١١٨﴾
parts.en: Did you think that We created you without purpose, and that you would not be returned to Us? So exalted is Allah, the King, the Truth; there is no god but Him, Lord of the noble Throne. Whoever calls on another god besides Allah, for which he has no proof, his reckoning is with his Lord alone; the disbelievers will not succeed. And say: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.

parts.ar: فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ ﴿١٧﴾ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ ﴿١٨﴾ يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَيُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ ﴿١٩﴾
parts.en: So glorify Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning. To Him is the praise in the heavens and the earth, in the late afternoon and when you reach midday. He brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living, and gives life to the earth after its death; and so you will be brought out.

parts.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
parts.en: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Shaytan.

parts.ar: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ﴿٢١﴾ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ ﴿٢٢﴾ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ﴿٢٣﴾ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ﴿٢٤﴾
parts.en: Had We sent down this Qur'an on a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and split apart in awe of Allah; these are examples We give people so they may reflect. He is Allah, besides whom there is no god, Knower of the unseen and the seen; He is the Most Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. He is Allah, besides whom there is no god: the King, the Holy, Peace, the Giver of Safety, the Watcher, the Mighty, the Compeller, the Supreme. Glory be to Allah above what they associate with Him. He is Allah, the Creator, the Maker, the Shaper; His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

parts.ar: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿٧٩﴾ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ ﴿٨٠﴾ إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ﴿٨١﴾
parts.en: Peace be upon Nuh among all the worlds. This is how We reward those who do good. He was one of Our believing servants.

parts.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
parts.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created.

parts.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
parts.en: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَسِتْرٍ، فَأَتْمِمْ نِعْمَتَكَ عَلَيَّ وَعَافِيَتَكَ وَسِتْرَكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
parts.en: O Allah, I have entered the morning in blessing, well-being and cover from You, so complete Your blessing, well-being and cover for me in this world and the Hereafter.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
parts.en: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness, and calling the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation to witness, that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone, without partner, and that our master Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.

parts.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، حَمْدًا يُوَافِي نِعَمَهُ وَيُكَافِئُ مَزِيدَهُ
parts.en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, a praise that matches His blessings and is equal to His increase.

parts.ar: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَكَفَرْتُ بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ، وَاسْتَمْسَكْتُ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى لَا انْفِصَامَ لَهَا، وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
parts.en: I believe in Allah the Mighty, I reject idols and false gods, and I hold to the firmest handhold, which never breaks; and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

parts.ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا وَرَسُولًا
parts.en: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with our master Muhammad ﷺ as Prophet and Messenger.

parts.ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.en: Allah is enough for me; there is no god but Him. On Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
parts.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace on our master Muhammad, his family and his Companions.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فُجَاءَةِ الْخَيْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فُجَاءَةِ الشَّرِّ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for good that comes suddenly, and I seek refuge in You from evil that comes suddenly.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
parts.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep to Your covenant and promise as far as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessing upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for no one forgives sins but You.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. On You I rely, and You are the Lord of the mighty Throne.

parts.ar: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.en: What Allah wills is, and what He does not will is not; and there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the High, the Mighty.

parts.ar: أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا
parts.en: I know that Allah has power over all things, and that Allah encompasses all things in knowledge.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا، إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
parts.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self and from the evil of every creature whose forelock You hold. My Lord is on a straight path.

parts.step: Do not leave me to myself
parts.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِكَ أَسْتَجِيرُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي، وَلَا إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
parts.en: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help, and from Your punishment I seek protection. Set right all my affairs, and do not leave me to myself, or to anyone of Your creation, for the blink of an eye.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
parts.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
parts.src: Sunan Abi Dawud; Sunan Ibn Majah

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ وَالْمُعَافَاةَ الدَّائِمَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon, well-being and lasting safety in my religion, my worldly life, my family and my wealth.
parts.src: Sunan Abi Dawud; Sunan Ibn Majah

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي
parts.en: O Allah, cover my faults and calm my fears.
parts.src: Sunan Abi Dawud; Sunan Ibn Majah

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
parts.en: O Allah, guard me from in front of me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me; and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unawares from beneath me.
parts.src: Sunan Abi Dawud; Sunan Ibn Majah

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنْتَ تَهْدِينِي، وَأَنْتَ تُطْعِمُنِي وَأَنْتَ تَسْقِينِي، وَأَنْتَ تُمِيتُنِي وَأَنْتَ تُحْيِينِي، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
parts.en: O Allah, You created me and You guide me; You feed me and You give me drink; You will cause me to die and You will give me life; and You have power over all things.

parts.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا، وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
parts.en: We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, the word of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and submitting, who was not of the idolaters.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ نَتَوَكَّلُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
parts.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening; by You we live and by You we die; on You we rely, and to You is the return.

parts.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
parts.en: We have entered the morning, and the dominion belongs to Allah; and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its opening, its help, its light, its blessing and its guidance.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا قَبْلَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهِ، وَشَرِّ مَا قَبْلَهُ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what is in it, the good of what is before it and the good of what is after it; and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what is in it, the evil of what is before it and the evil of what is after it.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ
parts.en: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have this morning is from You alone, without partner; so Yours is the praise and Yours the thanks for it.

parts.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
parts.en: Glory and praise be to Allah, as many as His creation, as much as pleases Him, as heavy as His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.

parts.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
parts.en: Glory and praise be to Allah the Mighty, as many as His creation, as much as pleases Him, as heavy as His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.

parts.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
parts.en: Glory be to Allah, as many as all He created in the heavens; glory be to Allah, as many as all He created on the earth; glory be to Allah, as many as all between them; glory be to Allah, as many as all He is creating.

parts.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
parts.en: Praise be to Allah, as many as all He created in the heavens; praise be to Allah, as many as all He created on the earth; praise be to Allah, as many as all between them; praise be to Allah, as many as all He is creating.

parts.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
parts.en: There is no god but Allah, as many as all He created in the heavens; there is no god but Allah, as many as all He created on the earth; there is no god but Allah, as many as all between them; there is no god but Allah, as many as all He is creating.

parts.ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
parts.en: Allah is the Greatest, as many as all He created in the heavens; Allah is the Greatest, as many as all He created on the earth; Allah is the Greatest, as many as all between them; Allah is the Greatest, as many as all He is creating.

parts.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
parts.en: There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the High, the Mighty, as many as all He created in the heavens; as many as all He created on the earth; as many as all between them; and as many as all He is creating.

items.note: In the evening, read the same wird with these changes: say أَمْسَيْتُ (amsaytu) for أَصْبَحْتُ, and أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ for أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ; say 'this night' (هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ) for 'this day'; and say اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.

parts.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، عَدَدَ كُلِّ ذَرَّةٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
parts.en: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His the praise; He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things: as many times as every atom, a thousand times over.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، مِفْتَاحِ بَابِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ، عَدَدَ مَا فِي عِلْمِ اللَّهِ، صَلَاةً وَسَلَامًا دَائِمَيْنِ بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ، عَدَدَ كُلِّ ذَرَّةٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
parts.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace on our master Muhammad, the key to the door of Allah's mercy, as many as all that is in Allah's knowledge, blessings and peace that last as long as Allah's dominion lasts, and on his family and Companions: as many times as every atom, a thousand times over.

sections.title: Imam al-Ghazali
sections.sub: A day of worship, from waking to sleep
sections.about: Imam Abu Hamid al-Ghazali رحمه الله (d. 505 AH) is called Hujjat al-Islam, 'the Proof of Islam'. He was a Shafi'i jurist, an Ash'ari theologian and a Sufi master. In his short book Bidayat al-Hidayah ('The Beginning of Guidance') he walks a beginner through one day of worship. These are all the du'as he teaches for each part of that day, in his own words and in his order: the same set that Imam al-Haddad's students published as 'The Ghazalian Supplications'.
sections.credit: Arabic from the Library's Bidayat al-Hidayah, checked letter by letter; tap 'In the book' under any du'a to see it there. A few scanning slips in that copy are corrected to the well-known wording (for example بظلماتك for بكلماتك, and أن تزل قدمي for آن تزول قدمي).

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the introduction; Sahih Muslim
items.when: The Prophet's ﷺ du'a, with which al-Ghazali opens the book
items.note: Al-Ghazali warns that knowledge sought for status only takes a person further from Allah, and quotes this du'a of the Prophet ﷺ.

parts.do: Before studying, and at any time:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَقَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَعَمَلٍ لَا يُرْفَعُ، وَدُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ
parts.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, a heart that is not humble, a deed that is not raised up, and a du'a that is not heard.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of waking

parts.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
parts.en: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the return.

parts.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْعَظَمَةُ وَالسُّلْطَانُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْعِزَّةُ وَالْقُدْرَةُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
parts.en: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah; greatness and authority, might and power belong to Allah, Lord of the worlds. We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, the word of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the way of our father Ibrahim عليه السلام, upright and submitting, who was not of the idolaters.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَبْعَثَنَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ إِلَى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ نَجْتَرِحَ فِيهِ سُوءًا أَوْ نَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ، أَوْ يَجُرَّهُ أَحَدٌ إِلَيْنَا، نَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهِ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهِ
parts.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and the evening, by You we live and die, and to You is the return. O Allah, we ask You to send us forth today to every good, and we seek refuge in You from committing evil today, or bringing it on a Muslim, or anyone bringing it on us. We ask You for the good of this day and what is in it, and seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what is in it.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the toilet
items.when: Going in, coming out, and after istinja'

parts.do: Step in with the left foot and say:
parts.ar: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الرِّجْسِ النَّجِسِ، الْخَبِيثِ الْمُخْبِثِ، الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
parts.en: In the name of Allah. I seek refuge in Allah from the filthy and unclean, the wicked one who leads to wickedness, the accursed devil.

parts.do: Step out with the right foot and say:
parts.ar: غُفْرَانَكَ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنِّي مَا يُؤْذِينِي، وَأَبْقَى فِيَّ مَا يَنْفَعُنِي
parts.en: I ask Your forgiveness. Praise be to Allah, who took away from me what harms me and left in me what benefits me.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنَ النِّفَاقِ، وَحَصِّنْ فَرْجِي مِنَ الْفَوَاحِشِ
parts.en: O Allah, purify my heart of hypocrisy and guard my chastity from indecency.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of wudu

parts.do: Sit facing the qiblah and say:
parts.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
parts.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Kind. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the promptings of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their coming near me.

parts.do: Wash both hands three times, then make your intention:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْيُمْنَ وَالْبَرَكَةَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشُّؤْمِ وَالْهَلَكَةِ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for good fortune and blessing, and I seek refuge in You from ill fortune and ruin.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى تِلَاوَةِ كِتَابِكَ وَكَثْرَةِ الذِّكْرِ لَكَ، وَثَبِّتْنِي بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ
parts.en: O Allah, help me to recite Your Book and remember You much, and make me firm with the firm word in this life and the next.

parts.do: Draw water into your nose three times:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَرِحْنِي رَائِحَةَ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَنْتَ عَنِّي رَاضٍ
parts.en: O Allah, let me smell the scent of Paradise while You are pleased with me.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ رَوَائِحِ النَّارِ وَسُوءِ الدَّارِ
parts.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the smells of the Fire and an evil abode.

parts.do: Wash your face, from the hairline to the chin and from ear to ear:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّضْ وَجْهِي بِنُورِكَ يَوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوهُ أَوْلِيَائِكَ، وَلَا تُسَوِّدْ وَجْهِي بِظُلُمَاتِكَ يَوْمَ تَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهُ أَعْدَائِكَ
parts.en: O Allah, brighten my face with Your light on the Day the faces of Your friends are brightened, and do not darken my face with Your darkness on the Day the faces of Your enemies are darkened.

parts.do: Wash your right arm up to and including the elbow:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي كِتَابِي بِيَمِينِي، وَحَاسِبْنِي حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
parts.en: O Allah, give me my book in my right hand and make my reckoning easy.

parts.do: Wash your left arm the same way:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي كِتَابِي بِشِمَالِي أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ ظَهْرِي
parts.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from being given my book in my left hand or from behind my back.

parts.do: Wipe your head with wet hands, front to back and back again:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ غَشِّنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ، وَأَظِلَّنِي تَحْتَ ظِلِّ عَرْشِكَ يَوْمَ لَا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلُّكَ، اللَّهُمَّ حَرِّمْ شَعْرِي وَبَشَرِي عَلَى النَّارِ
parts.en: O Allah, cover me with Your mercy, send down Your blessings on me, and shade me under Your Throne on the Day there is no shade but Yours. O Allah, forbid my hair and skin to the Fire.

parts.do: Wipe your ears, inside and out:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَسْمِعْنِي مُنَادِيَ الْجَنَّةِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
parts.en: O Allah, make me of those who listen to the word and follow the best of it. O Allah, let me hear the caller of Paradise, in Paradise, with the righteous.

parts.do: Wipe the back of your neck:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فُكَّ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ النَّارِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ السَّلَاسِلِ وَالْأَغْلَالِ
parts.en: O Allah, free my neck from the Fire. I seek refuge in You from the chains and the shackles.

parts.do: Wash your right foot up to and including the ankle, and between the toes:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْ قَدَمِي عَلَى الصِّرَاطِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ مَعَ أَقْدَامِ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
parts.en: O Allah, make my foot firm on the straight Bridge with the feet of Your righteous servants.

parts.do: Wash your left foot the same way:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ تَزِلَّ قَدَمِي عَلَى الصِّرَاطِ فِي النَّارِ يَوْمَ تَزِلُّ أَقْدَامُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ
parts.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from my foot slipping off the Bridge into the Fire, on the Day the feet of the hypocrites and idolaters slip.

parts.do: Look up to the sky and say:
parts.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي صَبُورًا شَكُورًا، وَاجْعَلْنِي أَذْكُرُكَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا، وَأُسَبِّحُكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
parts.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. Glory and praise be to You, O Allah; I bear witness that there is no god but You; You are the Relenting, the Merciful. O Allah, make me of those who repent, of those who purify themselves, and of Your righteous servants. Make me patient and grateful, and let me remember You much and glorify You morning and evening.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of going to the masjid

parts.do: Walk calmly and unhurried, and say:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ السَّائِلِينَ عَلَيْكَ، وَبِحَقِّ الرَّاغِبِينَ إِلَيْكَ، وَبِحَقِّ مَمْشَايَ هَذَا إِلَيْكَ، فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَخْرُجْ أَشَرًا وَلَا بَطَرًا، وَلَا رِيَاءً وَلَا سُمْعَةً، بَلْ خَرَجْتُ اتِّقَاءَ سَخَطِكَ، وَابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِكَ، فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُنْقِذَنِي مِنَ النَّارِ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You by the right of those who ask of You, by the right of those who long for You, and by the right of this walk of mine to You. I have not come out in arrogance or pride, nor to be seen or heard of; I came out fearing Your displeasure and seeking Your pleasure. So I ask You to save me from the Fire and to forgive me my sins, for no one forgives sins but You.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the masjid
items.when: Entering, and two things the Prophet ﷺ told us to say there

parts.do: Step in with the right foot and say:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي، وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
parts.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace on Muhammad, the family of Muhammad and his Companions. O Allah, forgive me my sins and open for me the doors of Your mercy.

parts.step: To someone buying or selling in the masjid
parts.ar: لَا أَرْبَحَ اللَّهُ تِجَارَتَكَ
parts.en: May Allah not make your trade profitable.

parts.step: To someone calling out for lost property in the masjid
parts.ar: لَا رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ ضَالَّتَكَ
parts.en: May Allah not return your lost property to you.

items.t: The du'a of the Prophet ﷺ after the sunnah of Fajr
items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the masjid; Sunan al-Tirmidhi
items.when: 10 parts, said together after the two rak'ahs of the sunnah of Fajr
items.note: Al-Ghazali tells you to say this in the masjid after the two sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr, then to keep to reflection, tasbih or Qur'an until the fard prayer.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، تَهْدِي بِهَا قَلْبِي، وَتَجْمَعُ بِهَا شَمْلِي، وَتَلُمُّ بِهَا شَعَثِي، وَتَرُدُّ بِهَا أُلْفَتِي، وَتُصْلِحُ بِهَا دِينِي، وَتَحْفَظُ بِهَا غَائِبِي، وَتَرْفَعُ بِهَا شَاهِدِي، وَتُزَكِّي بِهَا عَمَلِي، وَتُبَيِّضُ بِهَا وَجْهِي، وَتُلْهِمُنِي بِهَا رُشْدِي، وَتَقْضِي لِي بِهَا حَاجَتِي، وَتَعْصِمُنِي بِهَا مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for mercy from You, by which You guide my heart, gather my affairs, mend what is scattered in me, restore my closeness to others, set right my religion, protect what is hidden of me, raise what is seen of me, purify my deeds, brighten my face, inspire me to what is right, fulfil my need, and protect me from every evil.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا خَالِصًا دَائِمًا يُبَاشِرُ قَلْبِي، وَيَقِينًا صَادِقًا، حَتَّى أَعْلَمَ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُصِيبَنِي إِلَّا مَا كَتَبْتَهُ عَلَيَّ، وَرَضِّنِي بِمَا قَسَمْتَهُ لِي
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for pure, lasting faith that touches my heart, and true certainty, so that I know nothing will befall me except what You have written for me; and make me content with what You have given me.

parts.step: Faith with no disbelief after it
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا صَادِقًا، وَيَقِينًا لَيْسَ بَعْدَهُ كُفْرٌ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ رَحْمَةً أَنَالُ بِهَا شَرَفَ كَرَامَتِكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for true faith and certainty after which there is no disbelief, and I ask You for mercy by which I reach the honour of Your generosity in this world and the Hereafter.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْفَوْزَ عِنْدَ اللِّقَاءِ، وَالصَّبْرَ عِنْدَ الْقَضَاءِ، وَمَنَازِلَ الشُّهَدَاءِ، وَعَيْشَ السُّعَدَاءِ، وَالنَّصْرَ عَلَى الْأَعْدَاءِ، وَمُرَافَقَةَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for success at the meeting with You, patience with what You decree, the ranks of the martyrs, the life of the blessed, victory over enemies, and the company of the Prophets.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُنْزِلُ بِكَ حَاجَتِي، وَإِنْ ضَعُفَ رَأْيِي، وَقَصُرَ عَمَلِي، وَافْتَقَرْتُ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا قَاضِيَ الْأُمُورِ، وَيَا شَافِيَ الصُّدُورِ، كَمَا تُجِيرُ بَيْنَ الْبُحُورِ، أَنْ تُجِيرَنِي مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةِ الثُّبُورِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقُبُورِ
parts.en: O Allah, I bring my need to You, though my judgement is weak and my deeds fall short, and I am in need of Your mercy. So I ask You, O Decider of all affairs, O Healer of hearts, as You keep the seas apart, keep me apart from the punishment of the Blaze, from crying out in ruin, and from the trial of the grave.

parts.step: Every good you have not reached
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا قَصُرَ عَنْهُ رَأْيِي، وَضَعُفَ عَنْهُ عَمَلِي، وَلَمْ تَبْلُغْهُ نِيَّتِي وَأُمْنِيَّتِي، مِنْ خَيْرٍ وَعَدْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ، أَوْ خَيْرٍ أَنْتَ مُعْطِيهِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، فَإِنِّي أَرْغَبُ إِلَيْكَ فِيهِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ إِيَّاهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
parts.en: O Allah, whatever good my judgement fell short of, my deeds were too weak for, and my intention and hope did not reach, of any good You promised one of Your servants or any good You are giving one of Your creation: I long for it from You and I ask You for it, O Lord of the worlds.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا هَادِينَ مُهْتَدِينَ، غَيْرَ ضَالِّينَ وَلَا مُضِلِّينَ، حَرْبًا لِأَعْدَائِكَ، سِلْمًا لِأَوْلِيَائِكَ، نُحِبُّ بِحُبِّكَ النَّاسَ، وَنُعَادِي بِعَدَاوَتِكَ مَنْ خَالَفَكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
parts.en: O Allah, make us guides who are guided, neither astray nor leading astray; at war with Your enemies and at peace with Your friends. We love people with Your love, and we oppose, with Your opposition, those of Your creation who go against You.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا الدُّعَاءُ وَعَلَيْكَ الْإِجَابَةُ، وَهَذَا الْجُهْدُ وَعَلَيْكَ التُّكْلَانُ، وَإِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.en: O Allah, this is the du'a and the answer is from You; this is the effort and reliance is on You. To Allah we belong and to Him we return, and there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the High, the Mighty.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ذَا الْحَبْلِ الشَّدِيدِ، وَالْأَمْرِ الرَّشِيدِ، أَسْأَلُكَ الْأَمْنَ يَوْمَ الْوَعِيدِ، وَالْجَنَّةَ يَوْمَ الْخُلُودِ، مَعَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ الشُّهُودِ، وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ، الْمُوفِينَ لَكَ بِالْعُهُودِ، إِنَّكَ رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ، وَإِنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيدُ، سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تَعَطَّفَ بِالْعِزِّ وَقَالَ بِهِ، سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْمَجْدَ وَتَكَرَّمَ بِهِ، سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَنْبَغِي التَّسْبِيحُ إِلَّا لَهُ، سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْفَضْلِ وَالنِّعَمِ، سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجُودِ وَالْكَرَمِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي أَحْصَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِعِلْمِهِ
parts.en: O Allah, Possessor of the firm rope and the right command, I ask You for safety on the Day of the Threat, and Paradise on the Day of Eternity, with those brought near who witness, those who bow and prostrate, who fulfil their covenants with You. You are Merciful and Loving, and You do what You will. Glory be to the One who is wrapped in might and speaks by it; glory be to the One who is clothed in majesty and is generous by it; glory be to the One for whom alone glorification is fitting; glory be to the Possessor of bounty and blessings; glory be to the Possessor of generosity and nobility; glory be to the One who has counted everything by His knowledge.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا فِي قَلْبِي، وَنُورًا فِي قَبْرِي، وَنُورًا فِي سَمْعِي، وَنُورًا فِي بَصَرِي، وَنُورًا فِي شَعْرِي، وَنُورًا فِي بَشَرِي، وَنُورًا فِي لَحْمِي، وَنُورًا فِي دَمِي، وَنُورًا فِي عِظَامِي، وَنُورًا مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَنُورًا مِنْ خَلْفِي، وَنُورًا عَنْ يَمِينِي، وَنُورًا عَنْ شِمَالِي، وَنُورًا مِنْ فَوْقِي، وَنُورًا مِنْ تَحْتِي، اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنِي نُورًا، وَأَعْطِنِي نُورًا أَعْظَمَ نُورٍ، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
parts.en: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my grave, light in my hearing, light in my sight, in my hair, my skin, my flesh, my blood and my bones; light before me and behind me, on my right and my left, above me and below me. O Allah, increase me in light, give me the greatest light, and make light for me, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the masjid
items.note: Repeat each phrase of the adhan after the mu'adhdhin, except where a different reply is given here. If you hear the adhan while praying, finish the prayer and answer it after the salam.

parts.do: Repeat each phrase after the mu'adhdhin. At 'hayya 'ala al-salah' and 'hayya 'ala al-falah' say instead:
parts.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.en: There is no power and no strength except by Allah, the High, the Mighty.

parts.do: When he says 'Prayer is better than sleep':
parts.ar: صَدَقْتَ وَبَرَرْتَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
parts.en: You have spoken the truth and done well, and to that I am a witness.

parts.do: When he says 'The prayer has begun':
parts.ar: أَقَامَهَا اللَّهُ وَأَدَامَهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ
parts.en: May Allah establish it and keep it for as long as the heavens and the earth remain.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِنْدَ حُضُورِ صَلَاتِكَ، وَأَصْوَاتِ دُعَاتِكَ، وَإِدْبَارِ لَيْلِكَ، وَإِقْبَالِ نَهَارِكَ، أَنْ تُؤْتِيَ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You, at the coming of Your prayer, the voices of Your callers, the passing of Your night and the coming of Your day, to give Muhammad ﷺ the Wasilah, the excellence and the lofty rank, and raise him to the praised station You promised him. You do not break Your promise, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

parts.do: At sunset, after answering the adhan:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِنْدَ إِقْبَالِ لَيْلِكَ، وَإِدْبَارِ نَهَارِكَ، وَحُضُورِ صَلَاتِكَ، وَأَصْوَاتِ دُعَاتِكَ، أَنْ تُؤْتِيَ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You, as Your night comes on and Your day departs, at the time of Your prayer and the voices of those who call to You, to give Muhammad the Wasilah… and then continue as after the Fajr adhan.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the masjid

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَسَلِّمْ
parts.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، وَإِلَيْكَ يَعُودُ السَّلَامُ، فَحَيِّنَا رَبَّنَا بِالسَّلَامِ، وَأَدْخِلْنَا الْجَنَّةَ دَارَ السَّلَامِ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
parts.en: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace, and to You peace returns. Greet us, our Lord, with peace, and admit us to Paradise, the abode of peace. Blessed are You, Possessor of Majesty and Honour.

parts.ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَلِيِّ الْأَعْلَى الْوَهَّابِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، أَهْلُ النِّعْمَةِ وَالْفَضْلِ وَالثَّنَاءِ الْحَسَنِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
parts.en: Glory be to my Lord, the High, the Most High, the Giver. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His the praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die; in His hand is all good, and He has power over all things. There is no god but Allah, the One worthy of blessings, bounty and beautiful praise. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him, making our religion sincerely His, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the masjid

parts.do: The du'a the Prophet ﷺ taught 'A'ishah رضي الله عنها:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ، عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ، عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا يُقَرِّبُ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ وَعَمَلٍ وَنِيَّةٍ وَاعْتِقَادٍ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا يُقَرِّبُ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ وَعَمَلٍ وَنِيَّةٍ وَاعْتِقَادٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَكَ مِنْهُ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَمَا قَضَيْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ أَمْرٍ فَاجْعَلْ عَاقِبَتَهُ رَشَدًا
parts.en: O Allah, I ask You for all good, sooner and later, what I know of it and what I do not know; and I seek refuge in You from all evil, sooner and later, what I know of it and what I do not know. I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings near to it of word, deed, intention and belief, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and whatever brings near to it of word, deed, intention and belief. I ask You for the good that Your servant and Prophet Muhammad ﷺ asked You for, and seek refuge in You from the evil that Your servant and Prophet Muhammad ﷺ sought refuge from. And whatever You decree for me, make its outcome good.

parts.step: Do not leave me to myself
parts.do: What the Prophet ﷺ advised Fatimah رضي الله عنها to say:
parts.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِكَ أَسْتَجِيرُ، لَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي، وَلَا إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ بِمَا أَصْلَحْتَ بِهِ الصَّالِحِينَ
parts.en: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, O Possessor of Majesty and Honour, there is no god but You. By Your mercy I seek help, and from Your punishment I seek protection. Do not leave me to myself, nor to anyone of Your creation, for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs, as You set right the affairs of the righteous.

parts.do: Then say what 'Isa عليه السلام said:
parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ دَفْعَ مَا أَكْرَهُ، وَلَا أَمْلِكُ نَفْعَ مَا أَرْجُو، وَأَصْبَحَ الْأَمْرُ بِيَدِكَ لَا بِيَدِ غَيْرِكَ، وَأَصْبَحْتُ مُرْتَهَنًا بِعَمَلِي، فَلَا فَقِيرَ أَفْقَرُ مِنِّي إِلَيْكَ، وَلَا غَنِيَّ أَغْنَى مِنْكَ عَنِّي، اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُشْمِتْ بِي عَدُوِّي، وَلَا تَسُؤْ بِي صَدِيقِي، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتِي فِي دِينِي، وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّي، وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِي، وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيَّ بِذَنْبِي مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنِي
parts.en: O Allah, I have entered the morning unable to ward off what I dislike or to gain the good I hope for. The whole matter has come to be in Your hand, not in anyone else's, and I am held in pledge by my deeds. No one poor is poorer than I am before You, and no one rich is as free of need as You are of me. O Allah, do not let my enemy gloat over me, do not let my friend be grieved by me, do not let my affliction be in my religion, do not make this world my greatest concern or the limit of my knowledge, and do not, for my sins, set over me someone who has no mercy on me.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the masjid
items.when: After Fajr, before sunrise: each 10, 70 or 100 times
items.note: Al-Ghazali says: repeat each of these ten either a hundred times, seventy times, or ten times, which is the least, so that together they make a hundred. Keep to them, and do not speak before sunrise.

parts.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
parts.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.

parts.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ
parts.en: There is no god but Allah, the King, the Truth, the Clear.

parts.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
parts.en: There is no god but Allah, the One, the Overpowering, Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the Mighty, the Forgiving.

parts.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the High, the Mighty.

parts.ar: سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
parts.en: Glorified, Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

parts.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.en: Glory and praise be to Allah; glory be to Allah, the Mighty.

parts.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، وَأَسْأَلُهُ التَّوْبَةَ وَالْمَغْفِرَةَ
parts.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining, and I ask Him for repentance and forgiveness.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا رَادَّ لِمَا قَضَيْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
parts.en: O Allah, no one can withhold what You give, no one can give what You withhold, no one can turn back what You decree, and the wealth of the wealthy cannot avail him against You.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
parts.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace on Muhammad, and on the family of Muhammad and his Companions.

parts.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
parts.en: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manner of the prayer
items.when: What al-Ghazali teaches you to say in the prayer
items.note: Al-Ghazali was a Shafi'i. In the Hanafi school, open the prayer with سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ (thana'). Wajjahtu wajhi may be said before the opening takbir, and the du'a between the two prostrations is said in voluntary prayers.

parts.ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
parts.en: Allah is the Greatest, greatly; much praise be to Allah; and glory be to Allah morning and evening.

parts.ar: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
parts.en: I have turned my face to the One who created the heavens and the earth, upright and submitting, and I am not of the idolaters. My prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, who has no partner. This I have been commanded, and I am of those who submit.

parts.ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Mighty.

parts.ar: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ
parts.en: Allah hears the one who praises Him.

parts.ar: رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ
parts.en: Our Lord, to You is the praise, filling the heavens, filling the earth, and filling whatever else You will.

parts.ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى
parts.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.

parts.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَاعْفُ عَنِّي
parts.en: My Lord, forgive me, have mercy on me, provide for me, guide me, mend me, give me well-being and pardon me.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of sleep

parts.ar: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِاسْمِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي، اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَحْيَا وَأَمُوتُ
parts.en: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side and in Your name I raise it, so forgive me my sin. O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You raise Your servants. O Allah, in Your name I live and die.

parts.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا، إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ، وَأَغْنِنِي مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
parts.en: I seek refuge in You, O Allah, from the evil of every evil thing and every creature whose forelock You hold; my Lord is on a straight path. O Allah, You are the First, nothing is before You; the Last, nothing is after You; the Manifest, nothing is above You; the Hidden, nothing is beneath You. Settle my debt and free me from poverty.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَتَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا، إِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا، وَإِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدِّينِ وَالدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
parts.en: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it; its death and its life are Yours. If You take it, forgive it; if You let it live, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my world and the Hereafter.

parts.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَيْقِظْنِي فِي أَحَبِّ السَّاعَاتِ إِلَيْكَ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِأَحَبِّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَيْكَ، لِتُقَرِّبَنِي إِلَيْكَ زُلْفَى، وَتُبْعِدَنِي عَنْ سَخَطِكَ بُعْدًا، أَسْأَلُكَ فَتُعْطِينِي، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ فَتَغْفِرُ لِي، وَأَدْعُوكَ فَتَسْتَجِيبُ لِي
parts.en: O Allah, wake me at the hour most beloved to You and use me in the deeds most beloved to You, to bring me near to You and far from Your displeasure. I ask and You give me; I seek forgiveness and You forgive me; I call on You and You answer me.

items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of Jumu'ah
items.when: After the salam of the Friday prayer, before speaking
items.note: Before speaking, recite al-Fatihah, al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and al-Nas seven times each. Al-Ghazali says this protects you until the next Jumu'ah and guards you from Shaytan.
items.ar: يَا غَنِيُّ، يَا حَمِيدُ، يَا مُبْدِئُ، يَا مُعِيدُ، يَا رَحِيمُ، يَا وَدُودُ، أَغْنِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَبِطَاعَتِكَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، وَبِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
items.en: O Rich, O Praiseworthy, O Originator, O Restorer, O Merciful, O Loving: make me content with what You have made lawful, free of what You have forbidden; with obedience to You, free of disobeying You; and with Your bounty, free of all besides You.

daily.title: Daily du'as
daily.short: Waking, sleeping, eating, wudu, leaving home
daily.about: Short du'as the Prophet ﷺ taught for everyday moments. Imam al-Nawawi رحمه الله (d. 676 AH), the great hadith scholar, gathered them with their sources in his book al-Adhkar. Learn one at a time and say it each time that moment comes.

rabbana.title: The 40 Rabbana
rabbana.short: Du'as from the Qur'an that begin 'Our Lord'
rabbana.about: Forty du'as from the Qur'an that begin رَبَّنَا, 'Our Lord'. They are the words of the prophets عليهم السلام and the believers, which Allah kept in His Book. Many people read all forty after a prayer, or one a day. Some printed booklets count Fatir 35:34 or al-Tahrim 66:11 among the forty, but neither begins with رَبَّنَا, so this list has al-Nisa' 4:75 and the end of al-Hashr 59:10 in their place.

wird.title: Al-Wird al-Latif
wird.short: Imam al-Haddad's morning and evening wird
wird.about: Imam 'Abd Allah ibn 'Alawi al-Haddad رحمه الله (d. 1132 AH) of Tarim in Hadramawt gathered this short wird almost entirely from the Qur'an and the morning and evening du'as of the Prophet ﷺ. It takes about fifteen minutes. Read it once after Fajr and once after 'Asr or Maghrib, in this order, with the number of times shown on each line.

ghazali.title: Imam al-Ghazali's du'as
ghazali.short: A day of worship, from waking to sleep
ghazali.about: Imam Abu Hamid al-Ghazali رحمه الله (d. 505 AH) is called Hujjat al-Islam, 'the Proof of Islam'. He was a Shafi'i jurist, an Ash'ari theologian and a Sufi master. In his short book Bidayat al-Hidayah ('The Beginning of Guidance') he walks a beginner through one day of worship. These are all the du'as he teaches for each part of that day, in his own words and in his order: the same set that Imam al-Haddad's students published as 'The Ghazalian Supplications'.

prophets.title: Du'as of the Prophets
prophets.short: The words the Prophets عليهم السلام called on Allah with
prophets.about: The Qur'an keeps the very words with which the Prophets عليهم السلام turned to Allah: Adam عليه السلام in repentance, Yunus عليه السلام in the whale, Ayyub عليه السلام in illness, Musa عليه السلام in need, and our Prophet ﷺ asking for knowledge. Make them your own du'as.
